description: This source file defines the UserTurnProcessor class, a frame processor responsible for managing the lifecycle of user turns in a speech processing or dialogue system. It utilizes various turn strategies, handles frames related to user speaking events, and manages associated events and controllers such as UserTurnController and UserIdleController.

classes.name: UserTurnProcessor
classes.description: A class that processes frames to manage user turn lifecycle events, including starting, stopping, and idle time detection, integrating with turn controllers and emitting relevant events.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, user_turn_strategies: Optional[UserTurnStrategies] = None, user_turn_stop_timeout: float = 5.0, user_idle_timeout: Optional[float] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the UserTurnProcessor with optional strategies, timeouts, and event handlers, setting up turn and idle controllers.

methods.name: cleanup(self)
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the processor and its controllers.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes incoming frames to detect user turn start/stop and manage related state and events.

methods.name: _start(self, frame: StartFrame)
methods.description: Starts user turn processing, setting up necessary controllers.

methods.name: _stop(self, frame: EndFrame)
methods.description: Stops user turn processing and triggers cleanup.

methods.name: _cancel(self, frame: CancelFrame)
methods.description: Handles cancellation of frames and triggers cleanup.

methods.name: _cleanup(self)
methods.description: Performs cleanup of turn and idle controllers.

methods.name: _on_push_frame( self, controller, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection = FrameDirection.DOWNSTREAM )
methods.description: Handles the push of a frame downstream.

methods.name: _on_broadcast_frame(self, controller, frame_cls: Type[Frame], **kwargs)
methods.description: Handles broadcasting frames to other components.

methods.name: _on_user_turn_started( self, controller: UserTurnController, strategy: BaseUserTurnStartStrategy, params: UserTurnStartedParams, )
methods.description: Event handler called when a user turn starts, emitting corresponding frames and events.

methods.name: _on_user_turn_stopped( self, controller: UserTurnController, strategy: BaseUserTurnStopStrategy, params: UserTurnStoppedParams, )
methods.description: Event handler called when a user turn stops, emitting corresponding frames and events.

methods.name: _on_user_turn_stop_timeout(self, controller)
methods.description: Event handler called when a user turn stop times out.

methods.name: _on_user_turn_idle(self, controller)
methods.description: Event handler called when user has been idle for configured timeout.
